title: Temporal Generalization and Explanation Stability of Control Flow Graph Neural Networks for Malware Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.24280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Malware detection is a critical task in cybersecurity, and graph neural networks over control flow graphs have shown promising results for it. However, detectors are usually evaluated on a random split of a corpus collected over a single period, which cannot show how well a model generalizes to later samples. This study addresses that limitation with a strict temporal split: every model is trained on one period and scored once on a later one. Two corpora of control flow graphs, each node carrying 37 features, were extracted statically from 1,989 Windows portable executables: 459 graphs from 2024-2025 for training and 223 from 2026 for evaluation. Twelve variants and a flat-feature control were trained on the earlier corpus. translated_title: 面向恶意软件检测的控制流图神经网络的时间泛化与解释稳定性
translated_abstract: 恶意软件检测是网络安全中的一项关键任务，基于控制流图的图神经网络在其中已展现出令人鼓舞的效果。然而，检测器通常是在从单一时期收集的语料库上进行随机划分来评估的，这无法反映模型对未来样本的泛化能力。本研究通过严格的时间划分来解决这一局限：每个模型都在一个时期上训练，并在之后的时期上评估一次。研究从1,989个Windows可移植可执行文件中静态提取了两个控制流图语料库，每个节点携带37个特征：其中459个来自2024-2025年的图用于训练，223个来自2026年的图用于评估。十二种模型变体和一个平面特征对照组在较早的语料库上进行训练。结果表明，消息传递算子的选择显著影响了对分布偏移的鲁棒性，且每一个经过校正后仍然显著的成对差距都将聚合式架构与围绕学习到的注意力机制构建的架构区分开来。
tldr: 本研究通过严格的时间划分评估基于控制流图的图神经网络恶意软件检测器，发现消息传递算子的选择显著影响模型对未来时期样本的泛化鲁棒性，且聚合式架构与基于注意力机制的架构之间存在显著性能差异。
en_tdlr: Evaluating control flow graph neural network malware detectors under strict temporal splits, this study finds that the choice of message-passing operator significantly affects robustness to temporal distribution shift, with significant gaps separating aggregating architectures from those built around learned attention mechanisms.
